BAGELSMOD-SIMPLE_RUNE.title: Simple Rune
BAGELSMOD-SIMPLE_RUNE.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all your basic [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.title: Hunter's Blade
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and [red]Tender[/red].
BAGELSMOD-HUNTERS_BLADE.flavor: Crafted using the shell of a mighty bug. Wears easily then repairs itself.
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.title: Inklet Shawl
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Slippery[/gold]. At the start of your turn, if you have [gold]Slippery[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BAGELSMOD-INKLET_SHAWL.flavor: Comfortable and fashionable, although wearers eventually find it consumes them.
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.title: Elegant Rune
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.description: Upon pickup, remove [blue]3[/blue] cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and [red]Downgrade[/red] [blue]2[/blue] random cards.
BAGELSMOD-ELEGANT_RUNE.flavor: The answer was elegance. Of course.
BAGELSMOD-TOADPOLE_ARMOR.title: Toadpole Armor
BAGELSMOD-TOADPOLE_ARMOR.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold] and [gold]Thorns[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-TOADPOLE_ARMOR.flavor: The shell of a Sewer Clam melded with the spikes of a Toadpole. Grows to fit its wearer.
BAGELSMOD-BITING_BRACE.title: Biting Brace
BAGELSMOD-BITING_BRACE.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Whenever you take unblocked attack damage, lose [blue]2[/blue] Max HP.
BAGELSMOD-SHATTERING_CRYSTAL.title: Shattering Crystal
BAGELSMOD-SHATTERING_CRYSTAL.description: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] up to 3 [gold]Attacks[/gold] or [gold]Skills[/gold] with [gold]Fragile[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-SHATTERING_CRYSTAL.flavor: Perpetually locked in a state of almost breaking.
BAGELSMOD-WRITHING_TONGS.title: Writhing Tongs
BAGELSMOD-WRITHING_TONGS.flavor: These cursed tongs shift in your hand, but they seem at peace.
BAGELSMOD-BLESSED_CAULDRON.title: Blessed Cauldron
BAGELSMOD-BLESSED_CAULDRON.description: [gold]Elites[/gold] drop a [gold]Moment of Clarity[/gold] upon defeat.
BAGELSMOD-BLESSED_CAULDRON.flavor: Saps the lifeforce of deadly creatures and synthesizes it into pure bliss.
BAGELSMOD-DRAGON_EGG.title: Dragon Egg
BAGELSMOD-DRAGON_EGG.description: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all your card rewards. You can no longer [gold]Skip[/gold] card rewards.
BAGELSMOD-DRAGON_EGG.flavor: These have not been seen in aeons. Perhaps this is the last one.
BAGELSMOD-BLIGHTED_MUSHROOM.title: Blighted Mushroom
BAGELSMOD-BLIGHTED_MUSHROOM.description: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]66[/blue] and lose [blue]66[/blue] HP.
BAGELSMOD-BLIGHTED_MUSHROOM.flavor: The blight festering within this mushroom has made it more potent.
BAGELSMOD-DOUBLE_PENDULUM.title: Double Pendulum
BAGELSMOD-DOUBLE_PENDULUM.description: Every [blue]2[/blue] turns, draw [blue]3[/blue] cards. On other turns, draw [blue]1[/blue] less card.
BAGELSMOD-DOUBLE_PENDULUM.flavor: A toy for those who've lived a thousand lifetimes.
BAGELSMOD-MECHANICAL_BUTTERFLY.title: Mechanical Butterfly
BAGELSMOD-MECHANICAL_BUTTERFLY.descripti: At the start of your turn, EVERYONE gains [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-MECHANICAL_BUTTERFLY.flavor: Once alive, delicately preserved through slow replacement of parts with gears.
BAGELSMOD-SENSORY_STONE.title: Sensory Stone
BAGELSMOD-SENSORY_STONE.description: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]3[/blue] Upgraded Colorless Card Rewards.
BAGELSMOD-SENSORY_STONE.flavor: It illicts memories of the past upon touch.
BAGELSMOD-IMBALANCED_SCALES.title: Imbalanced Scales
BAGELSMOD-IMBALANCED_SCALES.description: Upon pickup, add an [gold]All Out[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-IMBALANCED_SCALES.flavor: No matter what is put on it, it never levels out.
BAGELSMOD-VOLATILE_CRYSTAL.title: Volatile Crystal
BAGELSMOD-VOLATILE_CRYSTAL.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]3[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold], remove [blue]3[/blue] random cards from your [gold]Deck[/gold], and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] random cards.
BAGELSMOD-VOLATILE_CRYSTAL.flavor: The legends say it ruptured the ground it was lodged in, creating the seas.
BAGELSMOD-ENTRAPPED_ENTROPY.title: Entrapped Entropy
BAGELSMOD-ENTRAPPED_ENTROPY.description: Upon pickup, fill your potion slots with [gold]Entropic Brews[/gold]. Whenever you use a potion, transform your hand.
BAGELSMOD-ENTRAPPED_ENTROPY.flavor: It constantly shifts, trying to figure some way to break out of its cage.
BAGELSMOD-TILT_A_WHIRL.title: Tilt-a-Whirl
BAGELSMOD-TILT_A_WHIRL.description: At the end of each turn, play a random card from your [gold]Hand[/gold], then [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a random card from your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BAGELSMOD-TILT_A_WHIRL.flavor: A miniature theme park ride. The Spire doesn't have these, so it's strange to see a model of one.
